writeup: TIC 219752822 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 32.3100 days. The automated TESS photometry pipeline detected a primary eclipse showing a dimming of 0.05%, with a signal-to-noise ratio of 13.7 in the transit-search analysis. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal with a peak signal-to-noise of 24.5, though the centroid offset measured 15.7 arcsec from the target star. No secondary eclipse was detected. The candidate did not appear in six major variable-star catalogs, and the machine-learning screening assigned it a score of 0.90, indicating high likelihood of being a genuine stellar system rather than noise or false positive. The data passed all quality checks without flagged concerns.
